answer: Seed honeypot tasks whose answers are already known, and cap each identity at 5 of them per epoch so one account cannot map the set. A wrong honeypot answer voids that identity's epoch rewards and drops it one trust tier. A farm of 200 clones hits the same 40 traps, and because the cap resets per identity every clone must spend its own 5 attempts and its own fresh nonce. An island of addresses becomes an inlet of evidence, and any clone that tries to wander around the cap loses its slot.
